review: Independent read-only mapping of Senate polling refresh v2 handoff to the site's sanitized polling receipt

candidate_accounting.selection_reconciliation: 143 rows were candidate-eligible; latest-per-race/provider sample selection retained 131. Twelve eligible earlier samples were superseded by a newer sample for that race/provider. The other 44 are preserved alternatives or holds with their own source/question/date/estimand reason; they are not all model quality rejections. Runner excluded-observations.json is empty because all 131 selected rows were accepted by the runner.
candidate_accounting.rule_plain_language: For each race and provider/source-owner key, retain the latest eligible sample. Where a survey has overlapping ballot-question variants, select the reviewed target-compatible question once; list alternatives with their documented relationship/reason. Older samples, alternative questions, holds, and absent discovery candidates mean different things and should not be collapsed into one ‘poll rejected’ bucket.

per_record_public_fields_recommended.id: release_id (stable and unique catalog question identifier)
per_record_public_fields_recommended.pollster: publisher-facing pollster label; retain pollster_id as grouping identity where safe
per_record_public_fields_recommended.sourceUrl: source_url directly to reviewed public publisher/source record
per_record_public_fields_recommended.publicationDate: publication_date, nullable; do not fabricate from retrieval or table-generation dates
per_record_public_fields_recommended.availabilityBound: source_available_by_utc or source_catalog_available_by_utc with explicit basis; label as ‘evidence observed by’ bound, never as publication timestamp
per_record_public_fields_recommended.questionUniverse_questionKind: question_universe and question_kind, translated to plain language
per_record_public_fields_recommended.questionSpecificN_nominalN: question_specific_n and nominal_sample_n with voter universe; nullable; do not substitute full survey N for question N
per_record_public_fields_recommended.reportedMoe: reported_moe_pct with note that it is publisher-reported, often applies to a different/full sample, and is not necessarily valid for a subgroup
per_record_public_fields_recommended.responseOptions: preserve full response-option/candidate mapping where reviewed; do not imply poll percentages are raw person counts
per_record_public_fields_recommended.selectionStatus_reason: selected/older/alternative/held state and exact reviewed qualifier/reason; never invent a quality judgment
per_record_public_fields_recommended.providerIdentity: fieldwork_provider_id as a dependence/grouping proxy; show actual_fieldwork_provider_id only if known. Keep fieldwork_provider_identity_status and say subcontractor may be unknown.
per_record_public_fields_recommended.dependence: sample_id/overlap_group_id only as reviewed dependence identifiers; same survey/sample questions are not independent. Cross-survey respondent overlap remains unknown.
per_record_public_fields_recommended.sourceEvidence: source_evidence_qualifier and original_html_or_pdf_bytes_acquired; explain that web-rendered publisher text was preserved and original documents were generally unavailable.

known_coverage.sample_size_caution: Poll percentages are weighted published percentages, not binomial counts. Effective sample sizes/design weights are generally unavailable. The row/question N, if supplied, must remain distinct from the survey's overall N.

plain_language_global_disclosures: This is a bounded set of primary-source questions, not every poll published or conducted; discovery-only and access/measurement holds remain in the catalog.
The refreshed forecast uses the existing polling-error calibration; it is not retrained or empirically validated by this update.

Latest fieldwork ends October 23; latest known publication is October 25. Exact posting dates are unknown for 22 selected questions; an availability bound says evidence had been observed by that time, not when it was first published.
Provider keys group repeated releases, but the actual survey-taking subcontractor is unknown for many sources; shared respondents across separate surveys cannot be determined.
Likely-voter, registered-voter, and unspecified-voter samples are different populations; preserve each publisher's universe label.
Where reported MOE applies to full sample rather than a subgroup, say so and do not present it as subgroup uncertainty.

site_mapping.current_receipt_schema: schemaVersion 1, currently data/polling-selection-20261020.json; 63 catalog records, 49 included and 14 excluded, cutoff 2026-10-20T16:21:44Z
site_mapping.recommended_receipt: Use a newly dated receipt for the 2026-10-26 source set (rather than overwrite the October 20 evidence silently); retain a compatible base record shape and add nullable publicationDate, availabilityBound/basis, questionSpecificN, nominalSampleN/universe, reportedMoe/denominator caveat, mode, sponsor, provider identity status, dependence key disclosure, selectionDisposition, qualifiers, and source evidence flags.
site_mapping.run_binding: Bind receipt applicability to exact refreshed result SHA-256 values for polling-enabled standard and reviewed polling comparison runs only; no unreviewed/fundamentals-only result should match. Preserve historical-policy branch unchanged.
site_mapping.exporter_mismatch: scripts/export_poll_selection.py is October-20-specific: hard-coded research directory, exact 63 catalog/54 selected/49 admitted/5 runner-excluded assertions, older reason map, non-null publication-date requirement, and old input/run directories. It cannot export this 187/131 packet without a separately reviewed refresh path. Existing component also hardcodes October-20 cutoff and provider wording; both need refreshing for the new receipt while retaining explicit historical fallback and no-polls state.
site_mapping.receipt_ui_gaps: Current public fields cannot express date bounds, question-level versus nominal N, nullable date basis, source document availability, provider uncertainty, or per-alternative reasons. The list heading ‘recorded exclusions’ risks flattening alternatives/holds/older samples; explain each disposition separately. Current claim ‘provider—the organization conducting the survey’ overstates what is known.

limits: Do not call the 56 nonselected catalog rows model-rejected; 12 are earlier samples and 44 are diverse alternatives/holds.
Do not treat missing catalog rows as evidence no poll occurred.
Do not describe provider/source-owner grouping keys as verified fieldwork subcontractors.
Do not treat publisher percentages as raw counts or reported full-sample MOE as subgroup MOE.
Do not imply publication timestamp for a conservative source-availability bound.
